examples.title: Add Text Annotation and Save PDF to MemoryStream
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding a text annotation to the first page, and saving the modified document to a MemoryStream for further processing without disk I/O.

examples.title: Edit PDF Pages In Memory Using PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Shows how to create a PDF in memory, rotate a page with PdfPageEditor, and save the edited document to another memory stream.

examples.title: Rotate First Page of PDF and Save with PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, rotate the first page using PdfPageEditor, and save the edited document to a new file.

examples.title: Create PDF Backup and Add Text Stamp
examples.description: Demonstrates how to copy a PDF for backup, load it with Aspose.Pdf, add a visible text stamp to the first page, and save the edited version as a new file.

examples.title: Extract and Rotate Selected PDF Pages
examples.description: Shows how to extract specific pages from a PDF, rotate those pages, and save the result as a new PDF using Aspose.Pdf's Facades and Document APIs.

examples.title: Get PDF Page Size with Error Handling
examples.description: Demonstrates retrieving the size of a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor and safely handling requests for non‑existent pages with try‑catch blocks.

examples.title: Validate and Apply PDF Page Rotation Safely
examples.description: Demonstrates how to validate a rotation angle before setting it on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf, handling invalid values and preventing runtime errors.

examples.title: Resize PDF Contents Using Custom Margins
examples.description: Demonstrates how to create a ContentsResizeParameters instance with specific margins and use PdfFileEditor to resize the contents of all pages in a PDF, then save the result.

examples.title: Save PDF with Incremental Update Using Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Demonstrates copying a PDF, adding a text annotation, and saving the document with incremental update mode to preserve the original file structure.

examples.title: Log PDF Page Modifications (Rotation, Size, Blank Detection)
examples.description: Shows how to rotate each page, resize pages to A4, detect blank pages, and log every property change to a text file using Aspose.Pdf and its Facades API.

examples.title: Merge PDFs with Uniform Page Size and Margins
examples.description: Demonstrates how to standardize page dimensions and margins for multiple PDFs using Aspose.Pdf, then merge the aligned documents into a single file.

examples.title: Rotate First Page of a Signed PDF
examples.description: Shows how to rotate a specific page in a digitally signed PDF using PdfPageEditor, preserving the existing signature.

examples.title: Generate PDF Page Properties Report with Size, Rotation, and Zoom Changes
examples.description: The example loads a PDF, records each page's size, rotation and zoom, modifies the page dimensions and rotation, applies a zoom factor using PdfPageEditor, and creates a text report showing the before‑and‑after values.

examples.title: Reset Page Rotation in PDF
examples.description: Shows how to reset the rotation of a specific PDF page (page 6) to 0 degrees using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Resize and Rotate PDF Page by 90 Degrees
examples.description: Shows how to read a PDF page's dimensions, enlarge the page canvas, and apply a 90° clockwise rotation using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Resize PDF Pages and Split into Chapters
examples.description: Shows how to resize all pages of a PDF to a uniform A4 size and then split the document into separate chapter PDFs using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Resize PDF Contents Only on Pages Containing Text
examples.description: The example detects which pages of a PDF contain any text and then enlarges the contents of only those pages using Aspose.Pdf's page editor.

examples.title: Set Page Six to Letter Size in PDF
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF, verify that page 6 exists, and resize that page to Letter dimensions (8.5" x 11") using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Resize PDF Page Contents with Custom Margins
examples.description: Demonstrates how to resize the contents of specific PDF pages (pages 2 and 4) by applying custom left and right margins using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

examples.title: Create Uniform Content Scaling Parameters with 15% Margins
examples.description: Demonstrates how to instantiate a ContentsResizeParameters object with 15% margins for uniform scaling of PDF page contents using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

examples.title: Resize PDF Page Contents with Asymmetric Margins
examples.description: Demonstrates how to resize the contents of all pages in a PDF using different left and right margins via Aspose.Pdf's ContentsResizeParameters and PdfFileEditor.

examples.title: Resize PDF Contents with Custom Top and Bottom Margins
examples.description: Demonstrates how to adjust the vertical spacing of all pages in a PDF by applying different top and bottom margins using Aspose.Pdf's ContentsResizeParameters and ResizeContents.

examples.title: Resize PDF Page Contents with Uniform Margins
examples.description: Shows how to apply equal margins to the contents of all pages in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's ContentsResizeParameters and PdfFileEditor.

examples.title: Shrink PDF Page Contents by 5% Using PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Demonstrates how to uniformly scale down the contents of every page in a PDF by applying a 5 % negative margin using the PdfPageEditor.Zoom property.

examples.title: Resize PDF Page Contents with 10% Margin
examples.description: Demonstrates how to apply a uniform 10 % margin to the contents of all pages in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's ResizeContents method.

examples.title: Resize PDF Pages While Preserving Annotations
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF, change each page to A4 size, and save it while keeping all annotations and interactive elements intact using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Resize PDF Pages from Byte Array
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a byte array, adjust the width and height of each page, and save the modified document to a new file.

examples.title: Resize PDF Pages to US Letter Size (Pages 3-6)
examples.description: Shows how to set the page dimensions of specific PDF pages to US Letter size using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Get Page Rotation Angle Using PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF file and retrieve the rotation angle of a specific page (page 4) using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Get Page Size After Rotation
examples.description: Loads a PDF, rotates a specified page by 90 degrees, then reads and displays the page's width and height after the rotation, and optionally saves the rotated document.

examples.title: Retrieve Page 2 Size from PDF
examples.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access the second page, obtain its width and height, and log the dimensions.

examples.title: Retrieve and Preserve Page Rotation After Resizing PDF Page
examples.description: The example loads a PDF, reads the rotation of the first page, changes the page size, saves the document, and then verifies that the rotation value remains unchanged.

examples.title: Revert PDF Page Size to Original Dimensions
examples.description: Loads a PDF, stores the original dimensions of a specific page, changes the page size, then restores the original size before saving the document.

examples.title: Rotate PDF Page and Reset Orientation
examples.description: Shows how to rotate the first page of a PDF by 90 degrees using Aspose.Pdf, save the result, then load the rotated file, reset the rotation to its original state, and save again.

examples.title: Rotate and Resize PDF Page to Letter
examples.description: Shows how to rotate page 3 of a PDF by 90 degrees and change its dimensions to Letter size using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Rotate Every Third PDF Page to Landscape
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, rotate each third page by 270° to achieve landscape orientation, and save the modified document.

examples.title: Rotate PDF Page from Memory Stream
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from an in‑memory byte array into PdfPageEditor, rotating the first page, and saving the modified document back to a file without using the file system for the source PDF.

examples.title: Load PDF and Rotate First Page with PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a local file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor, optionally rotating the first page, and saving the edited document.

examples.title: Rotate PDF Pages Based on Landscape Metadata
examples.description: Loads a PDF, reads a custom "Landscape" metadata flag, rotates all pages 90° clockwise when the flag is true, and saves the modified document.

examples.title: Rotate Second Page of PDF by 90 Degrees
examples.description: Shows how to rotate page 2 of a PDF by 90° using the PdfPageEditor.PageRotations dictionary and save the modified document.

examples.title: Process Encrypted PDF with Password Using PdfPageEditor and Document
examples.description: Demonstrates loading an encrypted PDF with a password, applying page‑level alignment via PdfPageEditor, then performing further manipulations such as page deletion and adding a text annotation using the Document API.

examples.title: Apply Transition and Rotate PDF Page by 180°
examples.description: Shows how to set a page transition effect with PdfPageEditor and then rotate the same page 180 degrees using the Rotation property.

examples.title: Rotate PDF Pages While Preserving Form Fields
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, rotating each page 90° clockwise, and saving the document while keeping interactive form fields intact.

examples.title: Rotate PDF Pages to Landscape for Brochure Printing
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, rotating portrait pages to landscape, and resizing each page to standard A4 landscape dimensions suitable for brochure printing.

examples.title: Rotate PDF Pages with Validation
examples.description: Demonstrates how to validate a rotation angle and apply it to all pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Rotate a PDF Page Using PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Shows how to rotate a specific page of a PDF by setting the Rotation property of PdfPageEditor and saving the modified document.

examples.title: Rotate Page 4 by 180 Degrees Using PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Shows how to rotate the fourth page of a PDF document by 180° directly with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Rotate Specific PDF Pages by 180 Degrees
examples.description: Demonstrates how to rotate selected pages (3, 5, and 7) of a PDF document by 180° using Aspose.Pdf and save the result.

examples.title: Apply BoxOut Transition to PDF Page

examples.title: Apply Cover Transition to PDF Page
examples.description: Shows how to set a Cover page transition with a 1‑second duration on page 4 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

examples.title: Set PDF Pages to A4 Landscape Size
examples.description: Shows how to change every page in a PDF to A4 landscape dimensions by setting PageInfo.Width and PageInfo.Height with Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Set Custom Page Size for PDF Pages
examples.description: Shows how to change the width and height of each page in a PDF by modifying the PageInfo properties using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Set Display Duration for Even-Numbered PDF Pages

examples.description: Shows how to configure the slide‑show display duration of page 5 in a PDF to five seconds using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Zoom Page and Add Centered Text Stamp at Specific Point
examples.description: Shows how to apply a 200% zoom to page 4 of a PDF and place a centered text stamp at coordinates (1,2) on the same page using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Set Last PDF Page Size to A5 for Booklet
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate the last page, and resize it to A5 dimensions to create a compact booklet format.

examples.title: Set Per-Page Display Duration Based on Word Count

examples.title: Set Per-Page Display Duration for PDF Slideshow
examples.description: Shows how to assign a custom display duration to each page of a PDF, creating a timed slideshow using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Set Page Transition Duration Based on Title Length
examples.description: Demonstrates how to apply a page transition to each PDF page and adjust the transition duration according to the length of a title (simulated with the page number). The example uses Aspose.Pdf to edit pages in a loop and save the result.

examples.title: Set Page Transition Duration for a Range of PDF Pages
examples.description: Demonstrates how to select a range of pages using PdfPageEditor and apply a 1‑second fade transition to them.

examples.title: Set Page Transitions (Fade, BoxOut, Cover) in PDF
examples.description: Demonstrates how to assign different page transition effects (Fade, BoxOut, Cover) to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Set Zoom to 100% for All PDF Pages
examples.description: Demonstrates how to set the zoom factor to 1.0 (100 %) for every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Set Zoom on Specific PDF Page
examples.description: Shows how to adjust the zoom level of page three in a PDF to 150 % using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Set PDF Page Size to Letter Portrait
examples.description: Shows how to resize every page of a PDF to the standard Letter portrait dimensions (8.5" x 11") using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Generate PDF Preview and Final Output with Zoom Scaling

examples.title: Export PDF Pages as PNG with Custom Zoom
examples.description: Demonstrates how to render each page of a PDF to PNG using a high‑precision zoom factor by adjusting the DPI via Aspose.Pdf's Resolution class.

examples.title: Set Page Display Duration Incrementally in PDF
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF and use PdfPageEditor to assign a DisplayDuration to each page, increasing the duration by one second for each subsequent page.

examples.title: Apply Different Page Transitions Sequentially in a PDF
examples.description: Shows how to assign a variety of transition effects to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf facades, then save and optionally concatenate the document.

examples.title: Set Slide Transition Duration in PDF Presentation
examples.description: Shows how to apply a uniform transition type and display duration (in seconds) to every page of a PDF, turning it into a timed presentation using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

examples.title: Set Split Transition on PDF Page
examples.description: Shows how to apply a Split page transition lasting two seconds to a specific page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

examples.title: Set Page Zoom to 75% Using PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Demonstrates how to set the initial view zoom of a specific PDF page (page 5) to 75% using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Set Zoom on Even PDF Pages
examples.description: Shows how to apply a uniform 0.8 zoom factor to all even‑numbered pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor facade.

examples.title: Apply Zoom to Odd PDF Pages
examples.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor to apply a 1.2× zoom factor to all odd‑numbered pages of a PDF and save the result.

examples.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor to apply a 2.0 zoom (200% magnification) to a specific PDF page and save the modified document.

examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with PdfContentEditor, attempting to align the content of page 3 to the middle vertically, and saving the document, while noting the need for a newer Aspose.Pdf version for the Alignment feature.

examples.description: Shows how to apply a 1.2 (120%) zoom factor to all even‑numbered pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Zoom PDF Pages Containing Images
examples.description: Shows how to detect pages that have image resources in a PDF and apply a zoom factor only to those pages using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Apply Password Protection to Existing PDF

examples.title: Batch Decrypt PDFs Using Owner Passwords from Config
examples.description: Demonstrates how to read a JSON configuration file and batch‑process multiple encrypted PDFs, decrypting each with its owner password using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with User and Owner Passwords
examples.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt all PDF files in a folder using the same user and owner passwords, applying specific permissions and saving the encrypted copies to an output directory.

examples.title: Standardize PDF User Passwords in a Folder
examples.description: Iterates through all PDF files in a directory, removes any existing encryption and re‑encrypts each document with a common user and owner password while preserving selected permissions.

examples.title: Change User and Owner Passwords for PDFs from CSV
examples.description: Shows how to read a CSV file containing PDF paths and new passwords, then apply user and owner password encryption to each PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Change User Password of Encrypted PDF
examples.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with the existing user password and re‑encrypt it using a new user password while keeping the original owner password, permissions, and encryption algorithm.

examples.description: Shows how to detect whether a PDF file contains extended usage rights by using the PdfFileSignature class from Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Encrypt PDFs with Algorithm Based on File Name
examples.description: Shows how to load PDFs, choose a CryptoAlgorithm according to naming conventions, apply passwords and permissions, encrypt the document, and save the encrypted file.

examples.title: Decrypt PDF with Owner Password
examples.description: Demonstrates how to verify if a PDF is encrypted and then decrypt it using the owner password with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

examples.title: Decrypt PDF Using Owner Password with Aspose.Pdf

examples.title: Disable Copying While Enabling Printing in PDF

examples.title: Encrypt and Decrypt PDF with Round‑Trip Verification

examples.title: Encrypt PDF with 256‑bit AES and Set Permissions
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply 256‑bit AES encryption with user and owner passwords, define print and content‑extraction permissions, and save the encrypted document.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Custom Permissions
examples.description: Demonstrates how to apply AES‑256 encryption to a PDF while specifying custom permissions such as printing and content extraction using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Upload to Cloud Bucket
examples.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using AES‑256 with user and owner passwords, then upload the encrypted bytes to a cloud storage bucket (simulated by a local file).

examples.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 from Byte Array
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a byte array, applying AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, and returning the encrypted PDF as a byte array.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF with Print and Edit Permissions (RC4‑128)
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, combining print and edit privileges, encrypting it with the RC4‑128 algorithm, and saving the protected document.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4‑40 using Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, apply RC4‑40 encryption with user and owner passwords, set permissions, and save the encrypted document using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF Stream with RC4‑40 using Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF from a stream, apply RC4‑40 encryption with user and owner passwords, and return the encrypted PDF as a new stream.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF and Return as MemoryStream
examples.description: Loads a PDF, applies AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, and saves the encrypted document into a MemoryStream ready for network transmission.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Permissions using Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying AES‑256 encryption with specific permissions, and saving the encrypted document while handling any exceptions.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF with User Password Only
examples.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by providing only a user password (owner password left empty) and setting specific permissions.

examples.title: Encrypt PDFs and Log Processing Time
examples.description: Loads each PDF from a folder, applies password protection with AES‑256 encryption and specific permissions, saves the encrypted file, and logs the time taken for each encryption operation.

examples.title: Load PDF and Verify Page Count
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf and confirm successful loading by reading the document's page count.

examples.title: Decrypt PDF with Incorrect Owner Password Throws Exception
examples.description: Demonstrates encrypting a PDF with user and owner passwords, then attempting to open it with a wrong owner password and verifying that an InvalidPasswordException is thrown.

examples.title: Remove Usage Rights from Signed PDF
examples.description: Demonstrates how to load a signed PDF, remove any extended usage rights, and save the resulting document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

examples.title: Remove Usage Rights from PDF and Verify Removal

examples.title: Generate PDF Encryption Report
examples.description: Scans a directory of PDF files, determines if each document is encrypted, and writes a CSV report with the encryption status (algorithm not exposed).

examples.title: Retrieve PDF Encryption Algorithm with Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Shows how to detect whether a PDF is encrypted and, if so, obtain the encryption algorithm using Aspose.Pdf, employing exception handling and reflection to access version‑specific properties.

examples.title: Modify PDF Privileges and Encrypt with Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Demonstrates setting user and owner passwords, defining print/extract permissions, and encrypting a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while allowing exceptions to propagate.

examples.title: Enable Form Filling and Disable Document Assembly in PDF
examples.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF with AES‑256 while granting only the FillForm permission, effectively allowing form filling and preventing document assembly.

examples.title: Set PDF Privileges: Allow Print, Block Copy

examples.title: Update Owner Password of Encrypted PDF

examples.title: Update Owner Password of Multiple PDFs While Preserving User Passwords
examples.description: Demonstrates how to batch‑process PDF files, re‑encrypting each with a new owner password while keeping the original user password unchanged. It uses Aspose.Pdf to load, encrypt, and save the documents safely.

examples.title: Decrypt Encrypted PDF After Encryption Check
examples.description: Demonstrates how to verify if a PDF is encrypted using PdfFileInfo and, if so, decrypt it with a password via Document, saving an unencrypted copy.

examples.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images (e.g., signatures) from a PDF and embed them into a simple HTML file for visual inspection.

examples.title: Extract Signing Certificate Subject from PDF

examples.description: Loads a PDF, locates the 'WitnessSignature' signature field, extracts its appearance image, and saves it as a PNG file.

examples.title: Verify PDF Signatures and Log Results to JSON

examples.title: Remove All Signatures from a PDF

examples.title: Remove All Signatures from PDFs Recursively

examples.title: Remove PDF Signature with Missing Field Error Handling

examples.title: Remove Signature from PDF

examples.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf to load an XML file, generate a PDF, and then convert that PDF to a single‑file HTML preview with embedded resources, including platform‑specific error handling.

examples.title: Enable Full‑Screen Viewer Mode for PDF Generated from XML
examples.description: Shows how to load an XML file into a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set the viewer's page mode to full‑screen using dynamic reflection for version‑agnostic support, and save the PDF.

examples.title: Generate PDF from XML with PDF 1.7 Compatibility
examples.description: Demonstrates loading XML data into an Aspose.Pdf Document, converting it to PDF version 1.7, and saving the output file.

examples.title: Generate PDF from XML using XSLT Configured via JSON
examples.description: Shows how to read XML, XSLT, and output PDF paths from a JSON config, apply the XSLT transformation to the XML, and create a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Convert XML to PDF using XSL‑FO with Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Demonstrates how to transform an XML document into XSL‑FO with .NET's XslCompiledTransform and then render the FO to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's XslFoLoadOptions.

examples.title: Generate PDF Table from XML Data
examples.description: Shows how to read tabular data from an XML file and create a PDF report with a formatted table using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Generate QR Codes from XML and Insert into PDF
examples.description: The example reads values from an XML file, creates QR code barcodes for each value, and places them on successive pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A with XML Error Handling
examples.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF to PDF/A using Aspose.Pdf while catching malformed XML exceptions to keep the process stable.

examples.title: Generate PDF from XML with Error Handling
examples.description: The example reads an XML file, extracts the text of the first <Message> element while handling parsing errors, and creates a PDF containing that text using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Insert Page Numbers into PDF using XSLT
examples.description: Demonstrates exporting a PDF to XML, applying an XSLT that adds page numbers, and re‑creating the PDF with the new pagination using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Insert Conditional Page Breaks in PDF from XML Content
examples.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file, extracting paragraphs, and adding them to a PDF while inserting new pages when a character count threshold is exceeded.

examples.title: Insert Dynamic Headers into PDF from XML per Page
examples.description: Shows how to read per‑page header text from an XML file and add it as a header to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Insert Footnotes into PDF Pages from XML
examples.description: Loads footnote definitions from an XML file and adds them as text fragments to the specified pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Merge PDFs Generated from XML Files
examples.description: Loads each XML file as a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's XmlLoadOptions, appends its pages to a target document, and saves a single merged PDF.

examples.title: Retry PDF Save on Transient I/O Errors
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, adding a page, and saving it with retry logic that handles transient IOException by retrying a configurable number of times with a delay.

examples.title: Populate PDF Form Fields from XML Records
examples.description: Loads an XML file, iterates over each Record element, and fills a PDF AcroForm with matching field values, handling checkboxes specially, then saves a separate PDF for each record.

examples.title: Preserve CDATA Sections from XML in PDF
examples.description: Shows how to load an XML file while preserving CDATA sections and render each CDATA block as monospaced, formatted text in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Register PDF Generation Service with Dependency Injection using Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Demonstrates registering an IPdfGenerator service in the DI container and using Aspose.Pdf to create a simple PDF document.

examples.title: Convert HTML CDATA Sections to PDF
examples.description: Loads an XML file, extracts CDATA sections containing HTML fragments, converts each fragment to PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf, and assembles them into a single PDF document.

examples.title: Render SVG Elements from XML into PDF as Vector Graphics
examples.description: Shows how to extract <svg> nodes from an XML file, load each SVG with Aspose.Pdf preserving vector graphics, and combine the resulting pages into a single PDF document.

examples.title: Repeat Table Header Rows on Each PDF Page
examples.description: Shows how to create a PDF table with a header row that repeats on every page when the table spans multiple pages using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Set Custom Page Margins from XML per Section
examples.description: Demonstrates how to read margin definitions from an XML file and apply them to specific page ranges in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Set PDF Page Transition Duration from XML
examples.description: Loads transition durations from an XML file and applies them to individual PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf, employing reflection to use PdfPageEditor without a compile‑time reference.

examples.title: Create PDF Pages with Custom Orientation from XML
examples.description: Shows how to read page size and orientation attributes from an XML layout file and apply them to Aspose.Pdf pages, adding a label that reflects the applied orientation.

examples.title: Set PDF Page Size from XML
examples.description: Loads an XML file that defines page width and height values and applies those dimensions to pages in an Aspose.Pdf document before saving the PDF.

examples.title: Create PDF with Page Size and Orientation from XML Processing Instructions
examples.description: The example reads custom processing instructions in an XML file to determine page size and orientation, then generates a PDF using Aspose.Pdf with the selected settings and adds a descriptive text fragment.

examples.title: Restrict Printing and Copying in PDF Generated from XML
examples.description: The example loads an XML file, converts it to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, and applies encryption with permissions that disable printing and content extraction.

examples.title: Set PDF Viewer Preferences When Converting XML to PDF
examples.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file as a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configuring viewer preferences such as fit‑window and page layout, and saving the result.

examples.title: Sign PDF Created from XML with Certificate
examples.description: The example converts an XML file to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, then adds a digital signature field and signs the PDF with a PKCS#7 certificate.

examples.title: Split PDF into Chapter Files Using Bookmarks
examples.description: Shows how to split a large PDF (generated from XML) into separate PDF files per chapter by using outline bookmarks to determine page ranges, with a fallback that creates one file per page when no bookmarks exist.

examples.title: Paginate XML Records into Multiple PDF Files
examples.description: The example reads a large XML file, extracts each <Record> element, and creates a series of PDF documents with a fixed number of pages per file, naming them sequentially.

examples.title: Transform XML with Multiple Namespaces to XSL‑FO and Generate PDF
examples.description: Demonstrates loading an XML document, applying an XSLT that emits elements in several namespaces, capturing the XSL‑FO output, and creating a PDF with Aspose.Pdf. It also shows how to avoid namespace conflicts by using a fragment writer.

examples.title: Validate XML against XSD and Generate PDF
examples.description: Demonstrates how to validate an XML file against an XSD schema using XmlReaderSettings, and upon successful validation creates a PDF with Aspose.Pdf that contains a confirmation message.

examples.title: XML to PDF conversion using XSL‑FO with Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Demonstrates transforming XML with XSLT into XSL‑FO and generating a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, covering simple conversion, parameterized XSLT, and external resources.
